connect_rosbridge_bson_client: connect to a ROS bridge server using RosbridgeBSONTCPClient with host and port configuration
send_bson_message: send a BSON-encoded dictionary message to the ROS bridge server via RosbridgeBSONTCPClient
receive_bson_message: receive and decode a BSON message from the ROS bridge server using recv_bson method
subscribe_ros_topic: subscribe to a ROS topic with message type using RosbridgeJSONTCPClient subscribe method
call_ros_service: call a ROS service like get_param using RosbridgeJSONTCPClient with callback handling
